title: A Birthday Party
description: Four short recordings about a birthday party: an invitation, ordering a cake, a message and the party itself.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · The invitation
parts.intro: You will hear Linh and Tom talking about a party.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Tom, my birthday party is on Saturday. Can you come?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Of course! How old are you going to be?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Thirteen. The party starts at three o'clock at my house.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Great. Is it a big party?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: Not very big. About ten friends. We're going to play games and have a barbecue in the garden.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: What would you like for a present? A book or a game?

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I'd love a book, please. I don't need any more games.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: OK. I'll bring a book about animals. I hope you have a wonderful day, and I'm sure your friends will enjoy the games and the food. See you on Saturday!

parts.title: Part 2 · Ordering a cake
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking to a baker.

script.speaker: Baker
script.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, I'd like to order a birthday cake for Saturday.

script.speaker: Baker
script.text: Of course. What flavour? We have chocolate, vanilla and strawberry.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: My friend loves strawberries, so strawberry, please.

script.speaker: Baker
script.text: Do you want a name on the cake?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes. Please write Happy birthday, Linh.

script.speaker: Baker
script.text: OK. It's eighteen pounds. Can you collect it on Saturday morning? We will make it fresh, and we will put it in a nice box for you.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, at about ten o'clock. Thank you!

parts.title: Part 3 · A voicemail
parts.intro: You will hear a message from Linh's aunt.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Hi, Linh. It's Auntie Hoa. Happy birthday for Saturday!

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: I'm sorry, but I can't come to your party. I'm going to be in Hue for my work.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: But I have a present for you. It's a red scarf. I'll give it to you on Sunday.

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Perhaps we can have lunch at the new noodle restaurant near your school. I'll pay!

script.speaker: Hoa
script.text: Call me tomorrow evening after eight. Bye bye, and have a lovely party!

parts.title: Part 4 · At the party
parts.intro: You will hear Minh and Mai at the party.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hi, Mai. This is a great party! The music is very good.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thanks. The food is nice too. Have you tried the pizza?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, but I don't like mushrooms. I prefer the chicken sandwiches.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Look, Linh is opening her presents. She loves the book from Tom.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: We must sing Happy Birthday soon. When's the cake coming?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: At five o'clock. After that, we're going to dance in the garden.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I can't dance very well! But I'll try. Oh, and I need to leave at six, because my father is picking me up.
